short_description: Fold a pixel sheet about horizontal and vertical creases until its ink matches a target silhouette.
description: Fold a pixel sheet about horizontal and vertical creases until its ink matches a target silhouette. Amber is the current sheet, pale green is the target. Rotate to select a horizontal or vertical crease; click folds the far side onto the near side. The two layers combine as a union. Start undoes a fold, hold Start resets the puzzle. Click after matching to advance. Every target is derived from legal folds of its starting sheet.
